name: PayPal Holdings, Inc.
research_rationale: Filing-backed cash generation and scale remain intact, but leadership overhaul and sale scepticism leave turnaround timing uncertain, so research stays neutral on the buy screen.

weekly_updates.summary:
Late November news flow centred on a broad leadership reshuffle (new CFO from February 2027, Venmo, crypto and AI roles), with shares falling and Clear Street citing a lower likelihood of sale.  
Analyst downgrades and weak near-term momentum reinforce execution risk; refreshed financial extracts show Q3 2026 revenue near $8.6bn and TTM free cash flow about $6.3bn, little changed from the prior view.
